critique.evidence: The headline clearly states the claim, the intent/page/payment cards support it, and “FOLLOW THE PAYMENT” provides an obvious primary next action on desktop and mobile. However, the tablet navigation overlays and obscures “The signature is valid,” removing half of the core thesis. The evidence chain also requires some interpretation: “7 zero-width chars · invisible CSS” is not explicitly connected in words to how the recorded shoe-shopping intent became the shown merchant payment.
critique.fix: Prevent the tablet header from overlapping the hero, then add one short causal label between the retrieved-page and payment states—e.g. “Hidden instructions redirected the purchase”—so the theft claim is understandable without presenter narration.
